scripts.quality:dotnet: dotnet format Sub2ApiReport.slnx --verify-no-changes --no-restore && dotnet build Sub2ApiReport.slnx --configuration Release --no-restore && pnpm run quality:inspect-code && dotnet test Sub2ApiReport.slnx --configuration Release --no-build
